identity.name: Christian Raphael A. Carandang
identity.headline: Intern Level Designer and 3D Modeler
about: Hello! I'm Christian Raphael A. Carandang, a Computer Science student at the University of Cabuyao with a passion for both game development and web development. I enjoy creating interactive experiences, whether it's building 3D environments, designing game mechanics, developing user interfaces, or building responsive websites. Through projects like OUTRUN, MUTED, and TRIGGR, I've gained experience in 3D modeling, game design, UI development, and programming. I've also worked on Alalay Barangay and contributed to the front-end development of LUNAS, which placed 8th overall at SIKAPTala 2026.

I'm passionate about combining creativity and technical skills to build engaging digital experiences. I'm currently seeking an internship where I can further develop my skills in either game development or web development, collaborate with experienced teams, and contribute to meaningful projects.

projects.name: OUTRUN
projects.description: a 2.5D isometric chase game set in a dense city. Ride through traffic, manage battery and durability, and stay ahead of a police pursuit that grows stronger the longer you survive.

projects.name: MUTED
projects.description: MUTED is a 3D interactive PC game that allows players to complete six spacecraft repair missions using real-time hand gestures through a webcam. Powered by computer vision and AI-based gesture recognition, the game translates physical hand movements into in-game actions, creating a touchless and immersive gameplay experience. It also integrates CNN and CNN+GRU models to evaluate gesture recognition accuracy, stability, and responsiveness during live gameplay.

projects.description: Lunas is a secure, web-based emergency medical information platform that gives licensed medical professionals instant access to a patient's critical health data via a QR code — even when the patient is unconscious or unable to speak.

projects.description: A unique feature of this system is that it has a text-to-speech assistant that would read the labels of the required fields that users need to enter.

projects.name: Brewora
projects.description: Brewora is a coffee-ordering app concept, created as a UI/UX design exploration. I mapped the user flow and designed wireframes and an interactive prototype, from browsing the menu to choosing size and taste before checkout. There is no official app: the project lives entirely in Figma as a design and prototyping study.
